E1d.provenance_notes: E1d trains strictly on MultiBully train splits (3,881 to 3,889 rows per fold). Validation splits (684 to 693 rows) are isolated for model selection and never used for training. Outer test splits (1,142 to 1,146 rows) partition the full 5,718 dataset.

E6b.provenance_notes: E6b trains on MultiBully train splits plus 1,424 retained supervised HOT auxiliary rows (5,305 to 5,313 actual training rows per fold). Exactly 1,765 zero-supervision rows are excluded. HOT auxiliary data is assigned strictly to training only (0 in val, 0 in test).

char_ngram_full_corpus.scope_description: 100% full corpus evaluated (all 18,234,702 pairs without token length filtering)

word_jaccard_candidate_scope.procedure_notes: Word-set Jaccard filters out texts with fewer than three tokens (113 MultiBully, 59 HOT) to prevent trivial 1-2 token collisions, evaluating 2,846,571 candidate pairs generated via shared inverted-index tokens.

cross_dataset_leakage_audit.methodological_limitation: Lexical overlap metrics (character TF-IDF and word Jaccard) detect surface and verbatim duplicates. They cannot establish semantic equivalence between paraphrases.

divergence_reconciliation.reconciliation_explanation: The figure 1,559 is the net marginal difference (3,139 - 1,580 = 1,559) between processed meme hate and text hate. The true count of visual-only bullying examples is 1,670 (29.21% of 5,718) in processed MultiBully, and 1,725 (29.41% of 5,865) in raw MultiBully.

section_details.A: Upstream raw HOT dataset ('dataset.csv') is absent from workspace; local curated files (hot_cleaned.csv, hot_v2.csv, hot_gold_only.csv) verified with zero pseudo-labels, but upstream pre-curation provenance cannot be independently completed on disk.
section_details.B: Observed distributions verified: Normal (1,121)->all 'non_hate'; Hate Speech (303)->all 'hate'; Offensive (1,765)->all masked (NaN).
section_details.C: 1,765 zero-supervision rows excluded; 1,424 supervised rows retained in train; 5 folds verify pairwise ID disjointness (0 train/val/test overlaps) and partition 5,718 unique test IDs.
section_details.D: 0 exact matches, 0 ID collisions, 0 near-duplicates (char >=0.85 or jaccard >=0.80), 0 fold test/val overlaps.
section_details.E: 1-to-1 ID merge verified (5,718 rows); discordance (1,670 vs 111, delta=1,559) reconciled; confounding averted.
